name: ionicon-scripts
content:
<script>
  import { onDestroy } from "svelte";
  
  const ioniconScript1 = document.createElement("script");
  ioniconScript1.type = "module";
  ioniconScript1.src = "https://unpkg.com/ionicons@8.0.13/dist/ionicons/ionicons.esm.js";

  const ioniconScript2 = document.createElement("script");
  ioniconScript2.noModule = true;
  ioniconScript2.src = "https://unpkg.com/ionicons@8.0.13/dist/ionicons/ionicons.js";

  document.head.appendChild(ioniconScript1);
  document.head.appendChild(ioniconScript2);
  
  onDestroy(() => {
    document.head.removeChild(ioniconScript1);
    document.head.removeChild(ioniconScript2);
  })
</script>
description: Add this component to the end of a HTML document to enable the use of ionicons (https://ionic.io/ionicons)
